description: This file implements the DeepElementAdded class, which manages the handling of GStreamer elements in a media pipeline, including registering callbacks for typefinding elements and updating playback group state based on element properties.

classes.name: DeepElementAdded
classes.description: A class that handles the event of a new element being added to a GStreamer pipeline, including setting up callbacks and updating internal state based on element properties.

methods.name: DeepElementAdded
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object, registers callbacks if the element is a typefind element.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the logic to update the playback group state based on the added element.
